notice.title: Zama is now fully native
notice.message: Zama has moved from a web app to a complete native app. But my love and support for Morphe hasn't changed one bit. A huge thank you to every developer out there creating and maintaining patches regularly. I won't name names because that wouldn't be fair, this community is filled with brilliant minds and every single one of you matters. Here's to the open community that makes all of this possible. - Zama

devProfile.name: Zama
devProfile.bio: Zama is the future, one commit at a time. No ads, no tracking, just code.

faqs.question: Why do scanner apps say Zama has trackers?
faqs.answer: Scanner apps like AppManager flag the Unity Ads SDK inside Zama. That SDK exists for exactly one feature: the optional ad-watching in the About tab (Fuel the Code), where watching ads earns you XP and unlocks badges. No analytics, no data mining, no data selling. The app is open source so anyone can verify it, and ads are 100% optional with nothing running in the background.

faqs.question: Is Zama Store safe?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Zama Store is completely open-source. This means our code is public on GitHub for anyone to audit. We believe in transparency—no hidden trackers, no data mining, just a clean gateway to apps.

faqs.question: Are apps on Zama safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. I personally review and mod them using tools available on their official repositories to ensure they are safe, functional, and privacy-respecting before they land here.

faqs.question: Are ReVanced builds safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. These builds are automated via GitHub Actions bots, not manually patched. They use the official ReVanced CLI and patches on APKs sourced from APKMirror, Uptodown, and APKPure. The process runs daily at 6 AM. The entire build pipeline is transparent and open-source: https://github.com/RookieEnough/Revanced-AutoBuilds

faqs.question: Installation failed?
faqs.answer: If you see 'App not installed' or 'Package conflicts', it's likely a signature mismatch. You cannot install a modded app over the original Play Store version or a different mod. Uninstall the existing app first, then install the one from Zama.

faqs.question: Download not working?
faqs.answer: Don't panic! Just head to the app's detail page and click the 'Report' icon (⚠️) in the top right corner. It opens a pre-filled report (a GitHub issue, or an email when a support address is configured) so I can fix it ASAP.

faqs.question: Will there be more apps?
faqs.answer: Yes, if there'll be more interesting apps to add on. As long as I find open-source or useful tools that deserve a spotlight, the library will keep growing.

faqs.question: How can I support?
faqs.answer: Star the project on GitHub, report broken or outdated apps when you spot them, and share it with people who'd find it useful. That is what keeps the catalog alive.

faqs.question: Is there any hidden easter egg?
faqs.answer:
Where the Architect stares, the secret sleeps.

Count the legs of a spider. Count the vertices of a cube.

Strike the Visage that many times.

The Golden Truth awaits those who know the rules... and so do I.
